contract: a railed enclosure with one gate, a crossing of paths, a lit monument at the centre, at least twelve grave markers of which no two share a shape, a height and a material - guaranteed by construction up to the 110 markers the vocabulary holds (six shapes, their real heights, ten stones), which a field of 37x33 does not reach - and a VAULT under it, walkable down from the gate and back
name: The Graveyard
